name: Sparse Voxel Ray Marching with AABB Exit Planes
aliases: Sparse Voxel Ray Marching with NAADF
voxel DDA with precomputed exit planes
definition: A ray marching algorithm that traverses a sparse voxel hierarchy (chunks, bricks, voxels) by computing the exit plane of the current cell using precomputed axis-aligned distance fields (AADF) stored in textures, avoiding per-voxel traversal when empty.
summary: Sparse Voxel Ray Marching with AABB Exit Planes is a ray traversal algorithm for sparse voxel hierarchies that skips empty space by computing exit planes using precomputed Axis-Aligned Distance Fields.
